title: Provide safe read-only discovery, inspection and task entry through gls

spec.description: Make a cold agent able to resolve source state and owning entry through the existing Library CLI and read canonical task scope without assembling several projections by hand.
objectives: Bounded search and exact Work inspection with source freshness checks.
Full canonical task inspection without a generated-site dependency.
Refuse traversal, symlink escape, stale inputs and inconsistent dossiers.
acceptance_criteria: Focused Node 20 read/add contract suites pass.
Real current-registry search/inspection returns the selected Runtime source and correct private/unselected Harness boundary.
A cold lower-capability reader can use the commands and return a checkable source receipt.
No input mutation or public deployment is performed.
spec.context: Implemented by a bounded context-clean Luna worker, with owner review corrections before acceptance. This is not a comparative token-efficiency result.

execution_log.action: Implementation and owner review completed; integration acceptance pending
